title: Reliable local telemetry networking and CI command tests
summary: The Collector addresses the viewer on Docker’s bridge, keeping host ports loopback-only. Promotion test requests close their sockets across synchronous commands. List-read integration sessions have a bounded 600-second startup and journey budget.
proves: The viewer regression fails first on the old host-gateway endpoint; the real Collector delivers the journey root, allowance.grant.insert child and trace-linked log to Tempo and Loki on Docker Desktop. Viewer, promotion and list-read tests pass with their original assertions. Lint, typecheck and generated drift checks pass. Linux CI on the fix remains the conductor’s landing check.

captions.01-fails-first: The new bridge endpoint assertion fails on the baseline implementation.
captions.02-viewer: The real viewer integration passes with the container address.
captions.03-touched-tests: Viewer, promotion and list-read integration checks, running real services.
captions.04-workspace-checks: Nx reset, sync, lint, typecheck and sync check.
captions.00-ci-baseline: Captured failures from the existing Linux CI runs, before this fix.
